title: Ninja H2 SX SE Supercharged (Urban Carbon)
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Kawasaki Ninja H2 SX SE Supercharged (Urban Carbon) is built for luxurious two-up cross-country expeditions with supreme wind protection. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against a curb weight of 108 kg, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Aggressive Forward Tuck posture paired with a balanced 820mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, backed by a 5.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
